newsitem.title: CHINA: China sees refining capacity rising 10 pct by 2000.
newsitem.headline: China sees refining capacity rising 10 pct by 2000.

text.p: China's annual processing capacity of crude oil is forecast at 220 to 230 million tonnes in 2000 compared with 199.80 million tonnes in 1995, a Chinese petrochemical industry executive said on Tuesday.

The annual crude oil processing capacity of major state oil refiner China Petrochemical Corp (Sinopec) is expected to reach 180 to 190 million tonnes in 2000 against 165.60 million tonnes in 1995, said Su Yimin, an adviser at Sinopec's China Petrochemical Consulting Corp.
Sinopec accounts for the bulk of China's refining capacity though other enterprises have refineries as well.
China's annual crude oil processing capacity is expected to hit 280 to 300 million tonnes in 2010, Su said in a speech at an industry conference in Beijing.
Meanwhile, China's annual ethylene production capacity will be 5.10 to 5.20 million tonnes in 2000, and eight to 10 million tonnes in 2010, she said.
China's annual production capacity for ethylene was 2.93 million tonnes in 1995, the most recent year for final figures, she said.
